_doc: Spec-compliance test fixture (v0.9) · 《午后茶歇》 archetype. Different product / different arc / different time-of-day from canonical storyboard_grid_morning_rush.json. Same §4 envelope shape · same 1-block × 8-panel narrative-comic structure · proves the spec is portable across archetypes.
_provenance: generated by Claude (tvc-director chatui canonical fixture self-check) on 2026-09-06 to verify the §4 spec + storyboardCanvas widget accept any narrative-comic block conforming to the v0.8 field set, not just the morning-rush example.
_mapping: same field map as storyboard_grid_morning_rush.json::_mapping. Fixture is intentionally a different product (午后冷萃茶 vs 早高峰冷萃咖啡) and a different arc (calm-return vs stress-relief) to exercise the spec rather than mirror the canonical example.

blocks.character_setup: [Character Lock: 30-36 female, East Asian, medium build, long dark hair tied back, linen blouse + cream trousers; face anchor: small dimple on left cheek]
blocks.vein: Single 30-second arc tracing one worker's midday slide → 4pm lull → balcony ritual → refreshed return. Soft documentary pacing, no dialogue; kettle-whistle + cicadas carry the release-and-return rhythm. Product (single-origin cold-steeped tea bottle) appears twice — once in panel 04 as the ritual anchor, once in panel 08 as the return reward.
blocks.audio_atmosphere: 14:50 keyboard clatter fades → 14:55 kettle whistle + porcelain clink → 15:00 balcony door slides open + cicadas → 15:05 ice-into-liquid 'clink' → 15:10 office hum returns. Quiet bed underneath; no music.
